media.title: Jev and AXe navigate Calendar and create an event in the iOS Simulator

title: Control the iOS Simulator with Jev and AXe
summary: Cameron Cooke demonstrates TypeSafe AI's Jev paired with AXe to navigate Calendar and create an event in the iOS Simulator from a natural-language prompt. The demo reports 11.6 seconds, six actions, no screenshots, and an estimated $0.0013 cost; Cooke describes the integration as a prototype with bugs and rough edges. An iOS team can use this experiment to define a bounded UI automation benchmark that measures latency, cost, and the resulting app state.
takeaway: Benchmark one repeatable Simulator task with explicit checks of the final app state, and measure total runtime and cost before drawing conclusions from the prototype's reported speed.
